bibl.title: The Regnal Canon in the Anthologies of Vettius Valens.
bibl.seg: Georges Declercq, The Regnal Canon in the Anthologies of Vettius Valens.
bibl.note: Tries to make sense of the regnal canon contained at the end of Anthologies I, 17 and to show how its original form can be restored. - Uses numerous papyrological parallels.
